summary: Patria Investments Ltd filed a Form 6-K containing unaudited condensed consolidated interim financial statements for the three-month periods ended March 31, 2026 and 2025. The filing includes statements of financial position, income, and comprehensive income, reflecting the company's financial performance and condition. There is no announcement of any special-situation transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender offer, deal termination, SPAC activity, or management change. The filing is a routine periodic financial report pursuant to Rule 13a-16 or 15d-16 under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. Therefore, this filing does not constitute a special situation.
